name: MedicationDrugClassForAllergenIntoleranceSCT
title: Medication drug class for allergen intolerance SCT
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
description:
Note: This set was initially developed in 2020. Annual updates to the value set definition have retained inactivated codes and added the suggested VSAC remaps. NO NEW DRUG CLASSES HAVE BEEN ADDED SINCE 2020.
Notes on the development of this value set:
1) This value set was developed to represent drug classes for medication allergens using SNOMED CT. The initial use case was to help the inbound interoperability side by guiding systems to recognize at least these classes upon receipt.
2) Concepts were first chosen from SNOMED CT’s Drug Product hierarchy when possible, then from the Substance hierarchy if no product match existed.
3) This approach leveraged NLM mappings between SNOMED CT drug products and RxNorm ingredients traceable to orderable drugs.
4) This is not a comprehensive list of drug classes.
 5) A note was added in 2021 May, to state it does not include vaccines, but the set has included vaccines since its inception. They have been retained in the 2025 update.
purpose: (Clinical Focus: Pharmacologic classification concepts drawn from SNOMED CT that are used to group products that have the characteristic represented by the class. Primarily used for allergen and intolerance substance classes preferentially with the product hierarchy.),(Data Element Scope: Medication drug class),(Inclusion Criteria: SNOMED CT drug class concepts representing commonly recorded allergy or intolerance classes. Concepts are drawn from the product hierarchy, when available, to support linkage to RxNorm prescribable products via RxClass.),(Exclusion Criteria: Drug class concepts from outside the product hierarchy when an equivalent concept exists within the product hierarchy.)
